failure.provider_rate_limit: rate limited. Try again in a minute.

failure.claude_cli_not_logged_in: not signed in. Sign in with the claude command in Terminal, then try again.
failure.claude_cli_quota: your plan’s usage limit is reached. Try again later.
failure.timeout: no answer in time. Try again.
failure.provider_not_configured: no provider is chosen yet. Choose one in Settings › AI providers.
failure.provider_key_missing: it has no API key yet. Add one in Settings › AI providers.
failure.claude_code_not_acknowledged: Claude Code is off until you allow it in Settings › AI providers.
failure.provider_model_not_found: it has no model by that name. Pick another in Settings › AI providers.
failure.provider_billing: the account is out of credit.
failure.payload_too_large: the question was too large for the model. Ask about one project.
failure.overloaded: it is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
failure.content_policy: it declined to answer this request.
